subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Black and white
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **In writing**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"black and white"** refers to something that is written down or printed, making it clear and unambiguous. (लिखित में)

 
 
• **Example: **The terms of the agreement were laid out in black and white.
 
 
 
• **"In writing"** means something that is documented or recorded in text. (लिखित में)
 
 
• **Example: **She made sure to get the contract in writing before starting the project.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **In writing**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Doubtful** (संदेहपूर्ण): Not certain or confident about something.

 
 
• **Example:** He was doubtful about the success of the new venture.
 
 
 
• **In dispute** (विवाद में): Subject to disagreement or argument.
 
 
• **Example: **The ownership of the land was in dispute for many years.
 
 
 
• **A false invention** (झूठी आविष्कार): Something that is fabricated or not true.
 
 
• **Example: **The story about the haunted house was just a false invention.

The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. refute.
